_comment: Tool-native detection credit (MITRE_TOOL_COVERAGE_PLAN.md). Each tool maps to techniques it was publicly evaluated against in MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations (evals.mitre.org) — per-step detection results are published there per vendor per round. v1 uses a conservative core set of techniques emulated across the recent Enterprise rounds (Wizard Spider & Sandworm 2022, Turla 2023, Scattered Spider & Mustang Panda 2025); refining any tool to its exact per-round results is a data-only change here. NEVER add a tool or technique without a published round behind it. IDs are test-enforced against the pinned attack.json (test_mitre_tool_coverage.py). Overlay semantics: separate labeled number, never merged into rule-based coverage.
caveat: Vendor-evaluated in MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations — not proof the alerts are tuned, monitored, or reaching your SOC.
